title: NFL’s Secret Superstars, Week 8: 3 under-the-radar standouts from the NFC

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL’s Secret Superstars, Week 8: 3 under-the-radar standouts from the NFC
sources.description: Gardner Minshew came off the bench to rally Arizona to an overtime win in Dallas. Bucky Irving and Kenneth Gainwell ran for 310 yards as the Bucs won without completing a pass. And Ty’Ron Hopper did something no Packer had done since Charles Woodson.
